sources: MLB Stats API schedule (primary, all years): https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/schedule?sportId=1&season=YYYY&gameType=F,D,L,W&hydrate=linescore,team (fetched 2026-10-11)
Retrosheet postseason game logs (game-by-game cross-check 2010-2025): https://www.retrosheet.org/gamelogs/glwc.zip, gldv.zip, gllc.zip, glws.zip
Wikipedia "2026 Major League Baseball postseason" (game-by-game cross-check 2026): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Major_League_Baseball_postseason
notes: date = officialDate from MLB Stats API (local date at venue; for postponed games, the date actually played).
series.teams = [Game 1 home team (higher seed), Game 1 away team]; wins aligned with teams.
Team codes are franchise codes (MLB AZ->ARI, ATH->OAK); see en_by_year for name changes.
2020: expanded 16-team format; best-of-3 Wild Card Series at higher seed; DS/LCS/WS at neutral sites (home = designated home team).
2012-2019 and 2021: single-game Wild Card; 2022+: best-of-3 Wild Card Series; 2010-2011: no wild card round.
